heading: Three ways to work with me
availability: Open to research collaborations and selected projects.

process.title: Brief
process.text: You describe the need, the context and any deadline — the form below or an email is enough.

process.title: Scoping call
process.text: A short call to agree on goals, constraints and what success looks like.

process.title: Proposal
process.text: A written proposal with scope, milestones and timeline.

process.title: Build and hand-over
process.text: Work in milestones with reviews, then hand-over with documentation and agreed support.

privacy_notice: I use what you send only to reply to you. Your message is stored on this site's server and sent to my inbox; it is deleted from the site after 12 months. Your IP address is not stored, only a one-way code used to limit spam. To have your message deleted sooner, email me.
